meta.home.description: An assistant that drafts the Algerian statement of claim in Arabic, offline on the lawyer's own computer, and checks every mandatory element before export.
hero.note: The demo runs a hosted model on fictitious cases only. The product itself runs offline.
site.offline: The desktop app works offline: client files never leave the lawyer's computer.
problem.heading: The problem
problem.title: One missing element, and the petition is rejected on form before a judge reads the merits.
problem.body: Every civil case in Algeria starts with the statement of claim. The Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure lists what it must contain; miss one element and the court rules it inadmissible on form. Lawyers draft it by hand, and they cannot send a client's file to a cloud AI service.
problem.finding.title: Defendant's name, surname and domicile
problem.finding.article: Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure, art. 15-3
proofs.title: What the software guarantees
proofs.texts.title: Official texts
proofs.texts.body: The complete Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure and the complete Family Code, with selected articles of the Civil, Commercial and Labour codes, all taken from the Official Journal and read against its pages.
proofs.offline.title: Works offline
proofs.offline.body: The only endpoint the model may use is the computer's own address. No cloud, no usage statistics, no silent updates: case data never leaves the machine.
proofs.review.title: Review before export
proofs.review.body: Every section written by the AI carries a mark, and no PDF or Word file leaves the app until the lawyer has reviewed each one and taken responsibility for it.
story.title: Nine steps, and every mandatory element is checked by code, not by AI.
story.lead: The case fills in step by step, and the petition takes shape on paper in front of you. The formal check points at the missing element at once and names the article that requires it.
story.missing: One mandatory element missing: the petition risks being declared inadmissible on form.
story.present: Every mandatory element the app checks is present. That does not make the claim admissible: substance, jurisdiction and time limits remain the lawyer's call.
story.caption: From the workbench: the formal state changes with every letter you type.
ai.title: The AI is a careful clerk. The lawyer signs.
ai.lead: The model runs on your computer and sees no law beyond what was loaded from the Official Journal. It reads the facts, proposes the claim type and the articles, then writes how the articles you ticked apply. The text of each article is quoted by code from the official source, never by the model.
ai.stage1.title: Reading the facts
ai.stage1.body: The model states the legal relationship, the obligation breached and what the claimant asks, and proposes a claim type from the catalogue without naming any article.
ai.stage2.title: Gathering candidate articles
ai.stage2.body: No model here: the software collects from the catalogue the articles this type of claim rests on, and abstains when no type applies.
ai.stage3.title: Choosing the articles
ai.stage3.body: The model picks only among the candidates and gives each article a role and a reason. Nothing is ticked until the lawyer confirms the claim type.
ai.measure: On a hidden test set of 90 fictitious cases (31 October 2026), the online model found the right claim type in 85 of 90 (94%) and got the whole case right in 60 of 90 (67%) in read mode. The local Gemma 3 4B got the whole case right in 32 of 90 (36%) with the claim type given.
ai.measureNote: Source: docs/HIDDEN-SET.md in the repository. These figures measure fact reading and article selection on fictitious cases, not the legal soundness of a petition.
ai.sign: The lawyer reviews, and the lawyer signs.
demo.title: Try it now in the browser
demo.body: The demo runs the same screens and the same law library, with a hosted model larger than the desktop's, on four fictitious cases. Enter no real data: the real product runs offline on your computer.
download.title: On your computer, offline
download.body: A Windows app that runs Gemma 3 4B locally through Ollama, or works without AI using ready templates.
download.req1: Ollama with the gemma3:4b model (about 3.3 GB)
download.req2: 16 GB of memory recommended; drafting the grounds takes about two minutes on an ordinary laptop
download.req3: Works without AI in template mode
team.title: Team
team.lead: Most of the code was written by AI coding agents, directed and reviewed by the project lead, and the app was tested on a laptop without a graphics card.
